{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Straight-leg trousers, full length, charcoal grey (#3B3F45), wool-blend suiting with a subtle texture
Fitted blouse, classic collar, long sleeves, ivory (#F2EBDD), matte silk-blend crepe
Refined knit cardigan, hip length, open front, camel (#B58B5A), fine merino wool
Slim leather belt, thin, dark brown (#4A3426), smooth calfskin
Loafers, low block heel, almond toe, dark brown (#4A3426), polished leather
Structured tote bag, medium size, taupe (#8C7B6B), grained leather
Small stud earrings, round, soft gold (#C9A24B), polished metal

This outfit sits right in the neat office band: a blouse with tailored trousers, a textured knit layer and loafers are the polished, professional pieces the workday asks for. The cardigan is the right amount of warmth for an autumn office, and it can come off if the room is warm. The charcoal, ivory and camel palette is calm and harmonious, so it looks put together without drawing too much attention. The trousers' straight line and the low heel keep everything comfortable for a full day of sitting, walking and meetings."}
